newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 7.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Ivorian Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan in the Netherlands to explore European markets. - Burkina Faso prime minister ends visit to Ivory Coast; two countries agree on concerted efforts to combat regional insecurity. - Nearly 37 million CFA francs snatched in holdup at Abidjan branch of BIAO bank; bank manager and cashier held hostage during robbery. LA VOIE - Cotton production in Franc Zone states of Africa booms -- now accounts for 75 percent of continental output, versus 20 percent 30 years ago. LE JOUR - Africa's major health scourges -- malaria, tuberculosis, meningitis and cholera -- making a strong comeback; a report on occasion of World Health Day.
